get.summary: Read Dew balance and prepaid storage allowance
get.description: Requires the account bearer. Returns account_id, asset_id, enabled, used_bytes, units_per_dew (1000000), monthly_units (1000000), yearly_units (10000000), and plan {period,expires_at,limit_bytes,balance}. Balance is integer millionths of Dew. The enabled node grants 10 MiB free, or 1 GiB until expires_at. Expiry blocks growth while preserving reads and deletions.

200.description: Account-scoped Dew balance and storage allowance; no-store

post.summary: Buy one month or one year of storage with Dew
post.description: Explicit prepaid purchase: monthly costs 1 Dew, yearly costs 10 Dew, each grants 1 GiB total. Extends unexpired time or starts now. Does not auto-renew. The debit and allowance commit atomically. Preserve request_id on uncertain results: repeating it never charges or extends twice; changing the period for the same ID is rejected. Monero funding uses the existing account subaddress and confirmed deposit reconciliation.

409.description: Request ID reused for another period

503.description: Upgrades disabled or unavailable; retain the request ID
